instruction: Put the red toy block on the orange tray.

attempts.code:
go_home()
obs = observe()
red_block = obs["objects"]["red_block"]
orange_tray = obs["zones"]["orange_tray"]

# Check if orange_tray is occupied
occupied = False
for obj_name, obj in obs["objects"].items():
    if obj["center"][0] < orange_tray["center"][0] + orange_tray["half_size"][0] and \
       obj["center"][0] > orange_tray["center"][0] - orange_tray["half_size"][0] and \
       obj["center"][1] < orange_tray["center"][1] + orange_tray["half_size"][1] and \
       obj["center"][1] > orange_tray["center"][1] - orange_tray["half_size"][1] and \
       obj["center"][2] < orange_tray["center"][2] + 0.01:  # slightly above tray surface
        occupied = True
        break

if occupied:
    # Clear the tray by moving the object to a free zone
    free_zone = None
    for zone_name, zone in obs["zones"].items():
        if zone_name != "orange_tray":
            free_zone = zone
            break
    if free_zone:
        # Move the object to the free zone
        obj_center = [free_zone["center"][0], free_zone["center"][1], free_zone["center"][2] + 0.02]
        move_to(obj_center[0], obj_center[1], 1.0)
        move_to(obj_center[0], obj_center[1], free_zone["center"][2] + 0.02)
        open_gripper()
        move_to(obj_center[0], obj_center[1], 1.0)

# Pick up red_block
move_to(red_block["center"][0], red_block["center"][1], red_block["top_z"] + 0.1)
open_gripper()
move_to(red_block["center"][0], red_block["center"][1], red_block["top_z"] + 0.02)
close_gripper()
wait(10)
if not obs["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grip red_block")

# Move to orange_tray
move_to(orange_tray["center"][0], orange_tray["center"][1], 1.0)
move_to(orange_tray["center"][0], orange_tray["center"][1], orange_tray["center"][2] + 0.05)
open_gripper()
move_to(orange_tray["center"][0], orange_tray["center"][1], 1.0)

goals.evidence: Put the red toy block on the orange tray.

constraints: The red_block must be moved from its current location to the orange_tray.
The orange_tray must be free of other objects before placing the red_block on it.
If the orange_tray is occupied, the occupying object must be moved first.
task_spec.refined_instruction: Move the red_block from its current location to the orange_tray. First, check if the orange_tray is occupied. If it is, clear the tray by moving any object currently on it to a free zone. Then, place the red_block on the orange_tray. Success is confirmed when the red_block is securely on the orange_tray and no other object is on the tray.
